item.title: Is This How It Ends? AARON STAINTHORPE Unsure If He’s Still the Vocalist of MY DYING BRIDE
item.description: Aaron Stainthorpe isn’t entirely sure whether he’s still the lead singer of My Dying Bride. The British doom metal band recently returned to the stage with Mikko Kotamäki, from Swallow the Sun, handling vocals.
